mapper.insert:
insert into b_xiecheng_colliding_data_log (sms_colliding_data_id, package_id, package_rule_id, data_source_type, cell_sha256_code_list, release_time, release_date, org_channel, mkt_level, info, `result`, market_coupon_list, coupon_code, coupon_desc, http_code, business_code, return_content, create_time, update_time) VALUES
(#{item.smsCollidingDataId}, #{item.packageId}, #{item.packageRuleId}, #{item.dataSourceType}, #{item.cellSha256CodeList}, #{item.releaseTime}, #{item.releaseDate}, #{item.orgChannel}, #{item.mktLevel}, #{item.info}, #{item.result}, #{item.marketCouponList}, #{item.couponCode}, #{item.couponDesc}, #{item.httpCode}, #{item.businessCode}, #{item.returnContent}, now(), now())
mapper.select: select * from b_xiecheng_colliding_data_log where is_delete = 0 and business_code = 707 and extend -> '$.isAlerted' = true and create_time >= #{createTimeStart} limit 1;

select max(create_time) as createTime from b_xiecheng_colliding_data_log where is_delete = 0 and result = true and business_code = 0 and http_code = 200 and create_time >= #{dateTimeStart} and create_time < #{dateTimeEnd};

select log.cell_sha256_code_list FROM b_xiecheng_colliding_data_log log left join b_xiecheng_colliding_data_rob rob on log.cell_sha256_code_list = rob.cell_sha256_code_list and rob.is_delete = 0 left Join b_xiecheng_colliding_data_loop_cycle dlc on log.cell_sha256_code_list = dlc.cell_sha256_code_list and dlc.is_delete = 0 WHERE log.create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), interval 1 day) and log.create_time < CURDATE() AND log.data_source_type = 'T' AND log.business_code = 0 AND log.is_delete = 0 and log.result = false and log.info is null and rob.id is null and dlc.id is null
select * from b_xiecheng_colliding_data_log where result = true and cell_sha256_code_list =#{sha256tel} order by create_time desc limit 1;
